'''Ganner Three''' was [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] designation in [[Second Galactic Civil War]] during [[Battle of Corellia (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Corellia]]. He served there as a part of the informal [[Ganner Squadron]].
